scene_without_labels: A traveler has deposited a brass token; her hand hangs above the dish as a keeper takes it inward. A calm community closes its last gap, and two people tension a rope across the sole path through the orchard. The traveler remains in the courtyard, holding a travel bag and leaning back.
causal_readability: The three visible acts deny the release she expected from the token return. The lane alignment links community geometry to her interrupted departure; bag, planted feet and recoil give the loss an immediate subject-level consequence.
reason_to_care: The individual traveler has surrendered the object that seemed to promise passage while organized strangers now control that passage. Her apprehensive response has a visible cause.
formal_direction: Bright beauty carries social unease. Primary attention goes to her face/hand and the dish; the closing human gap and rope lead attention to the lane; cream cloth and noon exposure keep the whole mechanism visible.
weakness_to_check_in_pixels: A token may read as an offering alone; a rope may look decorative unless its crossing of the sole lane and the attendants' pull are clear. A group may read as a pageant unless its attention, closure and the traveler's response connect. Pixel review must distinguish these cases honestly.
reference_readability_limit: A medium-wide scene may render the face less precisely than the portrait. Facial/hair fidelity must be inspected, not inferred from the prompt.
next_gate: Coordinator DATA_READY before project-local post-core retrieval.
